name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature.  Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace.  I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.

There is no salvation for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release.  Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down.  Please adventurer, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.
narrative.objectives: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I... I sense that the souls of those wolves you have put down now have rest. They - and I - thank you for a merciful release.

The wolves are not alone in their suffering within this damnable place, adventurer. Please, I have need of you once more.
narrative.requestItemsText: The wolves that are infected with the plague must be put down, adventurer.  The disease they carry cannot be cured.  I tried... I tried until I succumbed to the plague myself.
